title: Cursor MCP Setup + Blink Plugin: Full-Stack Infrastructure in 2 Commands
summary: How to add MCP to Cursor and connect Blink Cloud in 2 commands. Get database, auth, backend, and hosting inside your Cursor agent with npx skills add.
body_markdown: Blink Cloud is a full-stack infrastructure platform — database, auth, backend, hosting, and storage in one place. The Blink Cursor plugin gives your Cursor agent 80+ MCP tools to provision and manage all of it. Ask Cursor to build and deploy an app, and Blink handles the infrastructure layer automatically.
